admin.title: Student plans
admin.description: Give a student their copy of a study plan. There is one copy per student and plan, and the template does not change it after it is given.
admin.removeLoss: {done, plural, =0 {No points are ticked} one {# point is ticked} other {# points are ticked}} and {notes, plural, =0 {there are no notes} one {there is # note} other {there are # notes}}. They will be deleted with the plan and cannot be restored. You can give the plan again afterwards.

import.title: Import progress from a spreadsheet
import.intro: Upload the school's .xlsx: a tab per student, and «Залік» in the «Тип завдання» column marks a passed point. You see a preview first and nothing is written until you confirm. The file is not kept.
import.tooBig: The file is too big (4 MB at most).
import.unreadable: Could not read the spreadsheet. It must be an .xlsx with student tabs.
import.stateNew: no account and no plan yet
import.statePlan: already has the plan — only the rest is ticked ({done} already ticked)
import.skippedTitle: Skipped — no passed point in these tabs: {names}
import.sameStudent: Choose a different student for «{tab}»: another tab already goes to the same one.
